name: c8i-sizes-1
question: Does a smaller c8i host cost less per 1,000 tasks?

why.m8i-4xlarge: Control, identical to nested-hv-1's firecracker spec: expect 9 pass, 10 fail and about $0.068 per 1,000 tasks; a shift means drift, not a lever.
why.c8i-4xlarge: Same cores and clock as m8i at 11.5% less per vCPU, so only the price should move: expect the control's 9 pass, 10 fail and about $0.060 per 1,000 tasks.
why.c8i-2xlarge: Half the host: fewer tasks finish together and each uses less CPU. Expect 4 pass, 5 fail and about $0.056 per 1,000 tasks, at least 4% below c8i-4xlarge, as m8i.2xlarge was 6.5% below m8i.4xlarge.
why.c8i-xlarge: A quarter of the host: does the trend continue? Expect 2 pass, 3 fail and about $0.055 per 1,000 tasks, within noise of c8i-2xlarge.
